scenarios.scenario-1: Exit codes, typed errors, finding() and createEnvelope follow ADR-3/ADR-8.
scenarios.scenario-2: A non-MyGraceError is classified as INTERNAL with a debug hint, never silently swallowed.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output and JSON envelopes are asserted by the tests; no runtime log markers are emitted by library modules.
